summary: Independent review of the PXD031830 plaque sub-experiment (one TMTpro-16 batch, 16 samples x 80 fractions = 1280 rows). Every sample attribute matches the PRIDE sample sheet 'Plaque proteome' row-for-row; technical values match the paper Methods, the plaque pepXML search_summary and the raw header; all 80 plaque RAW files are mapped once and, with the 320 turnover files, cover all 400 deposited RAW files with no overlap. No blocker or important findings.

reviewer_context.context: fresh subagent without the producer transcript; earlier review-* dirs not read; producer manifest treated as untrusted and re-checked against primary sources

spec_compliance.evidence: 40 columns in canonical order; required columns of the ms-proteomics 1.1.0 + vertebrates 1.1.0 + clinical-metadata 1.0.0 union present (vertebrates/clinical-metadata are compatible: vertebrates excludes only human/invertebrates/plants). Reserved words only in columns allowing not available (sex, strain or breed, both tolerances: recommended, allow_not_available true). Age '3M/8M/12M' matches the spec age pattern. Modification strings NT/AC/TA|PP/MT well-formed, N-term TMTpro uses PP=Any N-term. (source name, assay name, comment[label]) unique (max count 1); (data file, label) unique.

ontology_integrity.evidence: Live OLS4 lookups (2026-11-13), all non-obsolete with matching labels: BTO:0002774 amyloid plaque, UBERON:0000955 brain, MONDO:0004975 Alzheimer disease, PATO:0000461 normal, EFO:0001272 adult, MS:1002523 Q Exactive HF, MS:1001309 Lys-C, MS:1001251 Trypsin, MS:1000422 beam-type CID, MS:1000484 orbitrap, PRIDE:0000627 DDA, PRIDE:0000564 hpHRP, PRIDE:0000608 DTT, PRIDE:0000599 IAA, UNIMOD:2016 TMTpro, UNIMOD:4 Carbamidomethyl, UNIMOD:35 Oxidation. sdrf-tools check: 20/20 verified, 0 UNIMOD swaps.

source_evidence.evidence: PRIDE_sample_information.xlsx sheet 'Plaque proteome' (16 sample IDs, genotype, age, region, TMTpro channel) matches source name/genotype/age/organism part/label for all 16 samples. Paper PMC11814087 Methods: Jackson stock #034848 (5xFAD) -> B6.Cg-Tg(APPSwFlLon,PSEN1*M146L*L286V)6799Vas/Mmjax; Lys-C then trypsin; DTT/IAA; basic-pH RP fractionation; Q-Exactive HF; 20 DDA MS2 at 60,000 resolution; HCD 32% NCE. pepXML plaque_f001.1.pepXML search_summary: static TMT +304.2071 on K and peptide n-term, static C +57.02146, variable M +15.99492, no Lys+6 (not SILAC). Raw header plaque_f080.raw: 'Q Exactive HF - Orbitrap MS'. Supplementary Data 2 (MOESM3 sheet '2', 136 rows) lists no plaque mice, so sex = not available is correct.

file_mapping.evidence: PRIDE v3 files/all re-fetched: 801 files, all projectAccessions=PXD031830; 400 RAW = mtob1 160 + mtob2 160 + plaque 80. Plaque SDRF references exactly plaque_f001..f080.raw (80), each with 16 channel rows and fraction identifier = file index; turnover SDRF references 320; intersection 0, union = all 400 RAW, none invented. Only vendor .raw in comment[data file].

design_consistency.evidence: 16 samples: 5xFAD plaque/non-plaque x 3/8/12 months x 2, plus WT brain at 8 and 12 months x 2; 1 batch, 80 fractions, technical replicate 1. Factors (age, genotype, organism part) vary and mirror their characteristics. Biological replicate 1/2 indexes the sample-ID suffix; plq/nonplq pairing to one mouse is not stated and the manifest says so. Age-genotype confounding at 3 months (no WT) is inherent in the deposit and disclosed.

omission_safety.evidence: No value asserts more than its source: sex and WT strain left not available; WT organism part 'brain' is the generic level (sheet Region N/A, all samples are brain sections) and declared INFERRED; no Lys+6 SILAC modification added to the plaque runs; mass tolerances left not available. Checked whether any source settles the tolerance: paper 10 ppm (generic TMT statement), PRIDE protocol 6/15 ppm (text describes only the 160-fraction pSILAC turnover batches), pepXML records no tolerance parameter, and isotope-corrected precursor errors of 8116 candidate hits in plaque_f001.1.pepXML are spread uniformly to a sharp edge at ~15-15.8 ppm, matching neither stated value. No source settles it, so 'not available' is justified.

deterministic_validation.evidence: flock parse_sdrf validate-sdrf -t ms-proteomics -t vertebrates -t clinical-metadata --use_ols_cache_only: exit 0 (one warning: strain string not in ncbitaxon, expected for a free-text strain). sdrf-tools check: exit 0, CLEAN. sdrf-tools score: 100/100. convert-openms fails only on the not-available tolerances (justified above).

findings.location: comment[precursor mass tolerance], comment[fragment mass tolerance] rows 1-1280
findings.message: Tolerances 'not available' are justified, but the limitation text could add the empirical observation: plaque_f001 pepXML candidates span ~+/-15 ppm precursor, contradicting the paper's 10 ppm.
findings.evidence: Isotope-corrected |ppm| quantiles 50/90/99/100% = 5.8/13.2/15.0/15.8 over 8116 search hits; uniform histogram 0-15 ppm.
